mapper.sql: id, user_id, capability_type, provider_code, base_url, api_key_cipher, api_key_iv, model_name, display_name, endpoints, dimension, supports_streaming, supports_thinking, priority, is_default, status, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM llm_config WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND capability_type = #{capabilityType} AND status = 1 AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY priority ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO llm_config ( id, user_id, capability_type, provider_code, base_url, api_key_cipher, api_key_iv, model_name, display_name, endpoints, dimension, supports_streaming, supports_thinking, priority, is_default, status, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, deleted ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{capabilityType}, #{providerCode}, #{baseUrl}, #{apiKeyCipher}, #{apiKeyIv}, #{modelName}, #{displayName}, CAST(#{endpoints,jdbcType=OTHER} AS jsonb), #{dimension}, #{supportsStreaming}, #{supportsThinking}, #{priority}, #{isDefault}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, 0 ) ON CONFLICT (user_id, capability_type, provider_code, model_name) WHERE deleted = 0 DO UPDATE SET base_url = EXCLUDED.base_url, api_key_cipher = EXCLUDED.api_key_cipher, api_key_iv = EXCLUDED.api_key_iv, model_name = EXCLUDED.model_name, display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name, endpoints = EXCLUDED.endpoints, dimension = EXCLUDED.dimension, supports_streaming = EXCLUDED.supports_streaming, supports_thinking = EXCLUDED.supports_thinking, priority = EXCLUDED.priority, is_default = EXCLUDED.is_default, status = EXCLUDED.status, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by
mapper.update: UPDATE llm_config SET deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM llm_config WHERE deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
